<span class="hl-kw">package</span> com.platform.events.iam.user;

<span class="hl-kw">import</span> java.util.<span class="hl-type">LinkedHashMap</span>;
<span class="hl-kw">import</span> java.util.<span class="hl-type">Map</span>;

<span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">record</span> UserLoggedInData(
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> email,
    <span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; federatedClaims,
    <span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; flowcatalystClaims,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> identityProviderCode,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> loginMethod,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> userId
) {

    <span class="hl-comment">@SuppressWarnings</span>(<span class="hl-str">&quot;unchecked&quot;</span>)
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> UserLoggedInData fromMap(<span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; map) {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> UserLoggedInData(
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;email&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt;) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;federatedClaims&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt;) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;flowcatalystClaims&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;identityProviderCode&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;loginMethod&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;userId&quot;</span>)
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; toMap() {
        <span class="hl-kw">var</span> map = <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-type">LinkedHashMap</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt;();
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;email&quot;</span>, email);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;federatedClaims&quot;</span>, federatedClaims);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;flowcatalystClaims&quot;</span>, flowcatalystClaims);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;identityProviderCode&quot;</span>, identityProviderCode);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;loginMethod&quot;</span>, loginMethod);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;userId&quot;</span>, userId);
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> map;
    }
}
